newsitem.title: COSTA RICA: Grenade found near Costa Rican government building.
newsitem.headline: Grenade found near Costa Rican government building.

text.p: Costa Rican police said they found a fragmentation grenade at a government building on Friday, just 48 hours after two similar grenades were discovered near the home of President Jose Maria Figueres.
An officer with the Intelligence and Security Directorate (DIS), Costa Rica's secret police, told Reuters an intense investigation has been launched.
The officer, who asked not to be identified, said the grenade was found on the roof of the Economy Ministry building in downtown San Jose.
On Wednesday, police discovered two grenades near the private home of Figueres on the same day that authorities received anonymous telephone threats against the president.
Figueres dismissed the threats and grenades as a "bad joke."
In the latest incident, authorities also received an anonymous phone call tipping them off to the explosive.
